pictures.name: night_stair_to_the_court
pictures.scene: a broad flight of worn stone steps climbing away into the dark, the lowest treads lit warm by one lamp out of frame, the long stair above them going up quietly into an unlit and altogether starless night

pictures.name: open_doorway_at_night
pictures.scene: a tall open doorway of dressed stone standing at the top of a dark court, warm light spilling out across the threshold at the bottom of the frame, the wall above the opening plain and deep in shadow

pictures.name: lamps_burning_in_a_dark_hall
pictures.scene: a row of small oil lamps burning steadily along a low stone ledge in a wide dark hall, their flames and the ledge lit warm and gold, the great space above them silent and entirely without any light

pictures.name: incense_rising
pictures.scene: a shallow bronze censer of glowing coals on a stone floor with one slow column of smoke lifting from it, the coals lit warm and red at the bottom of the frame, the dark air above them deep and calm

pictures.name: night_sky_over_the_ridge
pictures.scene: a long dark ridge of hills lying low across the bottom of the frame with a last warm line of light along its crest, the whole sky above it opening into an immense field of quiet and unhurried stars

pictures.name: city_under_stars
pictures.scene: a walled hill town seen far off and low at night with a scatter of warm window lights along its base, the hill and the sky above it rising into a great still dark that is full of faint stars
